Calculate the mass/charge (m/z) from molecular formula and adduct form

get_mass.Rd

If adduct is not given or [M] assumes a [M+H]+ or [M-H]- adduct if charge is not 0. Adduct must be one of "[M+H]+", "[M-H]-", "[M]+", "[M]-", "[M]".

Usage 

get_mass(formula, charge, adduct = "[M]")

Arguments

formula

Molecular formula as `character`, insert a space before atomic numbers

charge

Ion charge as a positive or negative `numeric`

adduct

Adduct type as a `character`, default is no adduct (`[M]`). See details.

Value

m/z as numeric

Details

Uses a modification of the `OrgMassSpecR` Function by Nathan Dodder. The modification allows for the addition of isotopes 2H, 13C 15N and 37Cl (a whitespace charachter must precede the isotope in order to separate it from the other elements). The adduct must be one of `[M+H]`, `[M-H]-`, `[M]+`, `[M]-`, `[M]`.

Examples 

# [M+H]+ Mass of Carbamazepine-13C15N
get_mass(formula = "C14 13CH12 15NNO", charge = 1, adduct = "[M+H]+")
#> [1] 239.1026
